{{Quote|A thousand apologies, my lord. Some Subjugates lack a proper understanding of our customs.|[[Sechel]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]|<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''Subjugate''' were a caste within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Resurgent Sith Empire]] who were yet to have been granted Imperial citizenship.

Consisting of non-imperial merchants, traders, civilians on conquered worlds, mercenaries and even off-world dignitaries, they were considered to all rank only slightly above servants on the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]; no matter how much power and influence they wielded on their homeworld.<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan" />
